sophia_sales: Quick snapshot from Pegasus POC run. Customer wanted predictable mixed latency under burst. Ran 150 qps steady with 25s microbursts to 420 qps. Topline: p95=245ms, p99=1.45s, max=3.6s, errors=0.7% (mostly long-gen timeouts). Need two things: a tight pricing delta for a tiny reserved burst pool and completed BYOK/KMS notes for their security team.

ravi_se: can you share the exact run and whether KV cache / embedding batching were enabled?

sophia_sales: run via perfbot: 
```
perfbot run --target https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  --concurrency 150 --duration 600 --schedule "soak:150:600,burst:420:25@300s" \
  --mix "chat:0.65,embed:0.25,long:0.1" --model redwood/gptx-7b:v2-int8 --region us-west-2
```
KV cache: ON for chat. Embedding batching: OFF for baseline.

luke_ops: infra notes: autoscaler saw spike and requested nodes at t+36s; vGPUs attached at t+132s due to cold allocation in the dedicated pool. That delay plus long-gen work explains tail. Recommend prewarm_nodes=1 or bump burst_window to 180s and enable adaptive embedding batching.

ravi_se: quick mitigation snippet: {"adaptive_batching":"true","embedding_batch_ms":"25","burst_window_secs":"180","prewarm_nodes":"1","request_timeout_secs":"14"}. Also suggest reserving a 2-node burst pool if they need consistent p99 for long-gen.

anne_prod: security ask: they require BYOK with HSM-backed CMK and a short KMS flow diagram. We support customer-managed CMKs via our KMS bridge; I'll prepare the flow doc and questionnaire answers.

sophia_sales: action items: ravi -> runbook PR with the snippet and prewarm how-to; luke -> post autoscale attach timings log; anne -> KMS flow doc + security answers; sales -> quick pricing delta for hosted vs 2-node reserved (ballpark for call). Aim to have numbers and docs by EOD tomorrow.

perfbot: marker: run_id=pegasus-2026-06-09 results_uploaded

sophia_sales: thanks team ":thumbsup:" will update customer after infra and pricing confirmation.
